acceptance_rule: At normal speed, both the motion and its observed direction must be recognizable in the unlabeled edited render before its answer is revealed. Every automatic and explicit direction variant must compare the exact source and edit, review and pass all required phases, and include a written evidence note. Numeric metrics cannot override a failed recognition or phase review, and any failure blocks the production audit receipt.

clap_single.recognizable_as: one chest-level clap directed with the surrounding dance or to the requested side
required_phases: hands begin apart
both hands approach each other
one visibly closed palm-to-palm contact occurs at chest level with relaxed diagonal fingers
the contact point moves forward, left, or right as requested without turning the torso to face the camera
the source root, torso, legs, and dance rhythm continue through the arm gesture
hands separate into the host dance

clap_repeat.recognizable_as: three chest-level claps directed with the surrounding dance or to the requested side
required_phases: hands rise to a chest-level guard
three visibly closed contacts occur with relaxed diagonal fingers and clear recoil
the contact point stays on the requested forward, left, or right side without resetting body facing
the source root, torso, legs, and dance rhythm continue throughout
hands stay near the guard between contacts
arms return without flapping to the hips
both arms rise above the head
palms visibly meet above the head without intersecting it
the overhead contact shifts toward the requested or inferred direction without a whole-body turn
the source root, torso, legs, and dance rhythm continue through the arm gesture
hands separate
arms lower into the host dance
both legs narrow into a stable stance
hips and knees visibly load downward
both feet push off and leave the floor
the body reaches one clear apex
the load, flight, and landing remain individually readable at normal speed
both feet land with bent-knee absorption
